top_signals.title: Power Turbine Stocks Dip as SoftBank Loss Fuels Fears
top_signals.summary: Shares of power and equipment firms like GE Vernova Inc. and Bloom Energy Corp. fell on Tuesday after SoftBank Group Corp. wrote down $3.7 billion in data center projects.

top_signals.title: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
top_signals.summary: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
